17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 1810 North Richmond Street, Chicago. IL
Proposed Zoning: | RM4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 3,000 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The existing 2.5 story residential building containing two (2) dwelling units
and a rear detached 2-car garage will remain. The Applicant plans to
incorporate additional square feet on the 2" floor and attic of the existing
building.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,007 sq. ft. (1.33 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
1,500 sq. ft. per unit

(2 dwelling units)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2 (Existing)
(D) _ Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 20’-11”

b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 1’-4” (Existing)
South Side:  3°-0 1/2” (Existing)

c. Rear Setback: 53°-9 1/4”
d. Rear Yard Open Space: 684 SF

(E) Building Height: 35°-7” feet
